governance.note: Structure, provenance and row-level FLAG counts only. No gene symbol, Ensembl ID, target gene, program gene or Stage75F edge was read, joined or enumerated from either workbook.

data_set_2.identity: Corces et al. 2020 Nat Genet, Supplementary Data Set 2
data_set_2.layout: matrix; rows = Cluster1..Cluster24, columns = 10 samples + a Total column; values = cell counts

CLUSTER24.internal_consistency: MATCH - sum over the 10 sample columns equals the sheet's own Total column

cross_validation.verdict: EXACT_MATCH - Data Set 2 and the GEO barcodes file describe the same 70,631 cells, so the cluster matrix is the authentic companion to the distributed peak sets

data_set_2.resolves: V60 audit open item 1 (microglial depth). The paper's 'less than 20%, grouped with astrocytes and OPCs' is now a number: 4,655 cells, 6.59% of the atlas, present in all 6 donor tokens.

MEASUREMENT_ERROR_CAUGHT_AND_CORRECTED.cause: first pass summed every column after Cluster_Description, which included the sheet's own Total column, exactly doubling the count
MEASUREMENT_ERROR_CAUGHT_AND_CORRECTED.detected_by: the atlas-wide sum came to 141,262 = 2 x 70,631, and 70,631 is the independently known barcode count
MEASUREMENT_ERROR_CAUGHT_AND_CORRECTED.class: same family as the barcodes header off-by-one earlier in V60 - a spreadsheet whose column semantics were assumed rather than read

data_set_9.identity: Corces et al. 2020 Nat Genet, Supplementary Data Set 9
data_set_9.separation_of_link_types: BY SHEET, not by a row filter. The V60 work order anticipated a method/type row-selector; none is needed.

sheet_hichip.name: HiChIP FitHiChIP Loop Calls
sheet_hichip.banner_verbatim: This page of the table shows the FitHiChIP loop calls that overlap SNPs derived from analysis of H3K27ac HiChIP data.

column_semantics_verbatim.Score: The -log10(q-value) of the loop call from FitHiChIP.
column_semantics_verbatim.Anchor1_hasSNP: A boolean variable determining whether the first anchor overlaps a SNP from our AD/PD GWAS analysis.
column_semantics_verbatim.Anchor2_hasSNP: A boolean variable determining whether the second anchor overlaps a SNP from our AD/PD GWAS analysis.

sheet_cicero.name: Cicero Coaccessibility
sheet_cicero.banner_verbatim: This page of the table shows the Cicero coaccessibility analysis for peaks that overlap SNPs derived from analysis of scATAC-seq data.
sheet_cicero.admissibility: INADMISSIBLE_INDEPENDENTLY_OF_THE_SNP_ISSUE - co-accessibility is a covariance estimator over ATAC and was excluded by the frozen V60 rule before this file was opened. Counted here only to document what Data Set 9 contains.

data_set_9.reason: The frozen object E = HiChIP contact edge INTERSECT Cluster-24 accessible regulatory element INTERSECT hg38-stable coordinate identity was frozen with the explicit exclusion 'no disease-locus filtering as a construction criterion'. Every one of the 11,542 distributed HiChIP rows is present BECAUSE an anchor overlaps an AD/PD GWAS SNP; zero rows are unconditioned. Disease-locus selection is therefore not a property that can be filtered out of this table - it is the table's inclusion criterion.
data_set_9.what_this_is_not: This is not a finding that the Corces HiChIP experiment is disease-selected. The experiment is genome-wide and the donors are cognitively healthy. It is a finding about the DISTRIBUTED ARTIFACT: Supplementary Data Set 9 publishes the GWAS-overlapping excerpt, not the map.
data_set_9.peak_id_bridge_noted: Cicero rows carry Peak_ID values such as sc_18453, described as 'A unique number that identifies the peak across supplementary tables'. A stable cross-table peak key exists in this supplement series. The HiChIP sheet does NOT carry it - its anchors are uniform 5,001 bp bins, not peaks.

consequence_for_the_corces_route.blocked_now: instantiating E from Supplementary Data Set 9
consequence_for_the_corces_route.not_yet_blocked: instantiating E at all - the 833,975 genome-wide loops may exist in another fully public distribution (GSE147672_RAW.tar, a GEO supplementary file, or another Data Set in this series). That has NOT been checked and must not be assumed either way.
consequence_for_the_corces_route.unchanged: Cluster-24 accessibility is confirmed adequate (4,655 cells, all 6 donors, 54,330 unique hg38 intervals). The accessibility half of E is not the blocker.
consequence_for_the_corces_route.still_open: the University of Washington / SEA-AD source-institution overlap, which no public donor-token-to-institution mapping resolves
